summary: This Form 8-K reports an amendment to a revolving credit agreement between BlackRock Monticello Debt Real Estate Investment Trust (the registrant) and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. The amendment extends the maturity date to May 20, 2027 (with potential further extension subject to JPM's consent) and modifies the applicable margin; all other material terms remain unchanged. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation event such as a restructuring, acquisition, or capital return.
